documents.title: Договор об условиях временного пребывания советских войск в ЧССР, 16 октября 1968 года
documents.publicationCitation: National Assembly 1964–1968, parliamentary print 208, treaty articles 1–2; ratification record 18 October 1968.
documents.notes: Articles 1–2 distinguish temporary Soviet troop deployment from Czechoslovak sovereignty. Pinned Natural Earth Czechia and Slovakia polygons supply generalized spatial exclusion masks; the treaty supplies the historical legal meaning.

documents.title: Natural Earth Czechia and Slovakia exclusion masks
documents.notes: Czechia and Slovakia provide a generalized spatial exclusion for occupation contamination. The 1968 treaty supplies the independent sovereignty evidence. These modern masks cannot establish the historical Soviet frontier; dated source geometry and Uzhhorod retention controls remain mandatory. No Runivers geometry is used.
